summary: Kerb on a street where cars park, warehouses opposite, flats about 19 m off.

best_section.where: East kerb of Central Avenue just north of the first bus stop, beside the building site

drivers.seclusion: Warehouses and sheds line the west side; the nearest flats are 19 m away and the new tower begins about 15 m further north.
drivers.access_and_room: Open street with cars parked at the kerb; no gate. Room beside the lane is ordinary parallel parking.
drivers.traffic: Through street used by buses; moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs, so a van would not stand out much. Bus zone signs sit near the south end and again further north.

flags: Bus zone signs near 0 m and about 160 m; keep clear
Flats 19 m away and a large new tower from about 40 m
Max grade 10.6% elsewhere on the stretch, gentle at this section
sun_shade: Mostly open; a few street trees on the east kerb and the tower casts afternoon shade over its length.
cannot_judge: Exact extent of the bus zone
